12483.name: Matthew Stafford
12483.note: Stafford left the locker room after Sunday's 24-9 win over the Chargers with a bag of ice wrapped on his right arm, and Rams coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday that the quarterback has been dealing with some arm soreness, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

14880.name: Kirk Cousins
14880.note: Cousins completed 19 of 26 passes for 247 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets. He added five rushing attempts for three yards and a rushing touchdown.

15168.name: Case Keenum
15168.note: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive but will operate as the Bears' emergency third quarterback for Monday night's matchup against the Seahawks.

15818.name: Keenan Allen
15818.note: Allen caught all seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.

15847.name: Travis Kelce
15847.note: Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

15864.name: Geno Smith
15864.note: Smith completed 20 of 32 passes for 290 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He also rushed once for four yards.

16731.name: Brandin Cooks
16731.note: Cooks caught one of three targets for 13 yards during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

16737.name: Mike Evans
16737.note: Evans (Achilles) is expected to return after San Francisco's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

16800.name: Davante Adams
16800.note: Head coach Sean McVay said Wednesday that Adams had successful surgery on his left hamstring, and the Rams are hopeful that the wide receiver will be able to return on the early side of his 6-to-10-week recovery timetable, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

2576925.name: Darren Waller
2576925.note: Waller corralled one of two targets for 11 yards during last Thursday's 27-19 loss at Green Bay.

2576980.name: Marcus Mariota
2576980.note: Mariota (knee) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

2577417.name: Dak Prescott
2577417.note: Prescott was 19-for-29 passing for 195 yards, one touchdown and no interceptions while rushing seven times for 20 yards and one more TD during Sunday's 33-30 overtime defeat to the Cardinals.

2578570.name: Jacoby Brissett
2578570.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Brissett will be removed from the starting role and serve as the Cardinals' No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

2969939.name: Jameis Winston
2969939.note: Winston turned four carries into four yards and a touchdown during the Giants' 27-21 overtime win over the Texans on Sunday.

2973405.name: Kalif Raymond
2973405.note: Raymond finished Monday's 34-17 win against Seattle with two catches for 14 yards on three targets along with one rush for 39 yards.

2976212.name: Stefon Diggs
2976212.note: Diggs caught three of six targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-10 win over the Eagles.

2977187.name: Cooper Kupp
2977187.note: Kupp caught one of three targets for a seven-yard touchdown Monday in a loss to the Bears.

2983509.name: Dare Ogunbowale
2983509.note: Ogunbowale didn't record an offensive touch or target in Sunday's 24-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

2991662.name: Mack Hollins
2991662.note: Hollins (calf), who is eligible to be activated from IR this week, per Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald, could return to practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

3040151.name: George Kittle
3040151.note: Kittle brought in eight of 10 targets for 88 yards and lost a fumble in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday.

3042519.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
3042519.note: Jones rushed five times for 22 yards and brought in both targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

3043078.name: Derrick Henry
3043078.note: Henry rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for seven yards in the Ravens' 36-10 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

3043116.name: Demarcus Robinson
3043116.note: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan reiterated Monday that Robinson (ankle) has a chance to return following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

3045147.name: James Conner
3045147.note: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

3045523.name: Kendrick Bourne
3045523.note: Arizona placed Bourne (tibia) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

3046439.name: Hunter Henry
3046439.note: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he had no update on Henry's (foot) status heading into Sunday's game against the Packers, Karen Guregian of MassLive.com reports. "I don't have any expectations yet," Vrabel said of Henry. "It's kind of how he responds here. He wasn't able to finish the [Week 8] game. So we'll see where he is, and I know Hunter will do everything he can to get back to help us."

3046779.name: Jared Goff
3046779.note: Goff completed 18 of 25 passes for 176 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added three carries for no gain in the Lions' 19-15 win over the Vikings on Sunday.

3051876.name: Evan Engram
3051876.note: Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in Sunday's 28-24 win over the Chiefs.

3052587.name: Baker Mayfield
3052587.note: Mayfield failed to complete any of his three pass attempts in the Buccaneers' 16-0 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also rushed four times for 14 yards.

3054850.name: Alvin Kamara
3054850.note: Kamara carried the ball six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

3068267.name: Austin Ekeler
3068267.note: Ekeler rushed eight times for 36 yards in Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

3116164.name: Mike Gesicki
3116164.note: Gesicki caught four of six targets for 76 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 43-36 overtime win against the Titans.

3116165.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
3116165.note: Godwin failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

3116365.name: Mark Andrews
3116365.note: Andrews caught three of four targets for 14 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

3116389.name: Samaje Perine
3116389.note: Perine rushed four times for 10 yards and caught his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

3116407.name: Mason Rudolph
3116407.note: Rudolph is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Teresa Varley of the Steelers' official site reports.

3117251.name: Christian McCaffrey
3117251.note: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

3117256.name: Dalton Schultz
3117256.note: Schultz caught five of six targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

3121023.name: Dallas Goedert
3121023.note: Goedert caught all four of his targets for 30 yards and added a two-yard run in Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.

3121422.name: Terry McLaurin
3121422.note: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

3122840.name: Deshaun Watson
3122840.note: Watson completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions while rushing three times for two yards in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

3123076.name: David Njoku
3123076.note: Coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that the Chargers likely will open the 21-day window for Njoku (fibula) this week, Alex Insdorf of BoltBeat.com reports.

3126486.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
3126486.note: Samuel (hamstring) has a chance to return following the 49ers' Week 8 bye, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

3127586.name: Jeremy McNichols
3127586.note: The Commanders placed McNichols (foot) on injured reserve Tuesday.

3128429.name: Courtland Sutton
3128429.note: Sutton (undisclosed) briefly left Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

3139477.name: Patrick Mahomes
3139477.note: Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added six rushing yards on two carries.

3843945.name: Foster Moreau
3843945.note: Moreau played 21 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in the Texans' 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants on Sunday.

3871102.name: David Sills V
3871102.note: Sills (hamstring) was activated from injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Thursday, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

3886598.name: Jauan Jennings
3886598.note: Jennings caught both of his targets for 11 yards in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

3895856.name: Christian Kirk
3895856.note: Kirk played 20 snaps on offense but didn't show up in the box score otherwise during Sunday's 29-20 loss to Atlanta.

3912547.name: Sam Darnold
3912547.note: Darnold completed 17 of 34 passes for 188 yards with two touchdowns and one interception while adding two rushes for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 34-17 loss to the Bears on Monday night.

3915416.name: DJ Moore
3915416.note: Moore indicated following Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens that he's okay in the wake of his late-game exit due to a knee issue, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

3915511.name: Joe Burrow
3915511.note: Burrow completed 38 of 48 passes for 462 yards with five touchdowns and three interceptions and added three carries for 10 yards and another score in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

3916148.name: Tony Pollard
3916148.note: Pollard rushed 21 times for 117 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

3916387.name: Lamar Jackson
3916387.note: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills that Jackson will undergo surgery to address his right thumb injury and will be placed on injured reserve,  Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

3916433.name: Jakobi Meyers
3916433.note: Meyers (hamstring/ankle) was listed as a limited participant in Tuesday's practice.

3917315.name: Kyler Murray
3917315.note: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Murray has a sore hamstring and will undergo a full evaluation as the Vikings look to determine the extent of the issue, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

3917792.name: Daniel Jones
3917792.note: Head coach Shane Steichen said that Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Cowboys, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

3917914.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
3917914.note: Zaccheaus (shoulder) is active for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.

3918298.name: Josh Allen
3918298.note: Allen completed 21 of 34 passes for 289 yards, two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He added 30 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown on seven rushing attempts.

3924327.name: Drew Lock
3924327.note: Lock (coach's decision/elbow) is inactive for Monday's matchup with the Bears but serving as the team's emergency quarterback, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

3925357.name: Calvin Ridley
3925357.note: Ridley caught one of three targets for 10 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

3929630.name: Saquon Barkley
3929630.note: Barkley said after Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders that he has received assurances from the Eagles front office that he will remain with the team beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline, Tim McManus of ESPN.com reports. "The whole time my mindset was, we have a little issue going on right now and I feel like I'm the type of player and the type of leader that can help us get out of it," Barkley said. "And I want to be one of the reasons why we fix it."

3929645.name: Juwan Johnson
3929645.note: Johnson caught one of three targets for seven yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

3930066.name: Van Jefferson
3930066.note: The Commanders signed Jefferson to the active roster Wednesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

3930086.name: Dawson Knox
3930086.note: Knox caught one of two targets for six yards in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens.

4032473.name: Rashid Shaheed
4032473.note: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Tuesday that Shaheed (knee) has a chance to play Sunday against the Cardinals, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

4035537.name: Kene Nwangwu
4035537.note: Nwangwu was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

4035538.name: David Montgomery
4035538.note: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he has "no significant update" on the status of Montgomery (groin) heading into a Week 9 matchup with the Chargers, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

4035671.name: Tyler Huntley
4035671.note: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said Tuesday that Huntley (toe) could be a candidate for injured reserve, Sam Cohn of The Baltimore Sunreports.

4035687.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
4035687.note: Pittman (foot) said Monday that he resumed running last week as part of a program to return, but the wideout acknowledged that he's without a clear timeline to be activated from injured reserve, Ray Fittipaldo of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette reports.

4035886.name: Khalil Herbert
4035886.note: Herbert reverted to the Falcons' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

4036131.name: Noah Fant
4036131.note: Fant gathered in all two targets for 11 yards during Sunday's 16-10 defeat against Pittsburgh.

4036133.name: T.J. Hockenson
4036133.note: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-15 loss to the Lions.

4036378.name: Jordan Love
4036378.note: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

4037235.name: Greg Dortch
4037235.note: Dortch went without a target while logging four of the Bills' 82 snaps on offense in Sunday's 36-10 win over the Ravens. He returned one kickoff for 22 yards and three punts for 40 yards.

4038441.name: Justice Hill
4038441.note: Hill (groin) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice.

4038524.name: Gardner Minshew II
4038524.note: Head coach Mike LaFleur announced that Minshew will step in as the Cardinals' new starting quarterback beginning with Sunday's game at Seattle, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

4038815.name: Rico Dowdle
4038815.note: Dowdle rushed 15 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

4038941.name: Justin Herbert
4038941.note: Herbert completed 24 of 32 passes for 257 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions while rushing four times for 15 yards in the Chargers' 24-9 loss to the Rams on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with the Chargers.

4040655.name: Darnell Mooney
4040655.note: Mooney caught one of three targets for four yards and rushed once for three yards during Sunday's 27-21 overtime win against the Texans.

4040761.name: Devin Singletary
4040761.note: Singletary is expected to handle a bigger role out of the Giants' backfield after Tyrone Tracy (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

4045305.name: Ian Thomas
4045305.note: Thomas (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

4047365.name: Josh Jacobs
4047365.note: Head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that the Packers are aware of the prior physical abuse allegations involving Jacobs that recently surfaced and "anticipate him being a member" of the team moving forward, Ryan Wood of USA Today reports.

4047646.name: A.J. Brown
4047646.note: When asked whether Brown (ankle/knee) might practice at some point this week, coach Mike Vrabel said Monday, "We'll see," Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

4047650.name: DK Metcalf
4047650.note: Metcalf brought in one of six targets for four yards in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.

4048228.name: John Bates
4048228.note: Bates (shoulder) is active for Sunday night's matchup with the Eagles.

4212909.name: David Moore
4212909.note: Moore didn't receive any playing time on offense and logged two snaps on special teams in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.

4239993.name: Tee Higgins
4239993.note: Higgins secured 10 of 11 targets for 155 yards and two touchdowns in the Bengals' 43-36 overtime win over the Titans on Sunday.

4239996.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
4239996.note: Head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne (hamstring) will be evaluated Monday before the Saints make a determination whether he practices this week, Ross Jackson of WWL Louisiana reports.

4240472.name: Noah Gray
4240472.note: Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

4240577.name: Brandon Smith
4240577.note: The Steelers signed Smith off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Teresa Varley of the team's official site reports.

4241263.name: Charlie Kolar
4241263.note: Kolar caught one of four targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Rams.

4241389.name: CeeDee Lamb
4241389.note: Lamb recorded seven catches (on 11 targets) for 58 yards during Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

4241416.name: Chuba Hubbard
4241416.note: Hubbard rushed 22 times for 81 yards and a touchdown and brought in seven of eight targets for 38 yards in the Panthers' 27-19 loss to the Packers on Thursday.

4241424.name: Tylan Wallace
4241424.note: Wallace recorded a three-yard reception on his lone target in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

4241463.name: Jerry Jeudy
4241463.note: Jeudy did not catch his lone target Sunday in Cleveland's 27-6 loss to Pittsburgh.

4241476.name: Tyrell Shavers
4241476.note: The Bills designated Shavers (knee) to return from the reserve/PUP list Wednesday, but he will not play against the Ravens on Sunday, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

4241555.name: Elijah Mitchell
4241555.note: Mitchell reverted to the Eagles' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.

4241820.name: Sam Ehlinger
4241820.note: Ehlinger (coach's decision) is inactive but will be the third emergency quarterback against the Chiefs on Sunday, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

4241985.name: J.K. Dobbins
4241985.note: Dobbins carried the ball seven times for 13 yards in Sunday's 28-24 win over Kansas City.

4242335.name: Jonathan Taylor
4242335.note: Taylor rushed eight times for 23 yards and brought in four of five targets for 24 yards in the Colts' 42-7 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

4242355.name: Jake Ferguson
4242355.note: Head coach Brian Schottenheimer said Monday that Ferguson (ankle) has a chance to play Sunday at Indianapolis, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.

4242433.name: Joshua Palmer
4242433.note: Palmer (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Ravens.

4242512.name: Malik Willis
4242512.note: Willis completed 21 of 32 passes for 211 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 24-19 loss to New England. He gained two rushing yards on his only carry.

4243331.name: Cade Otton
4243331.note: Otton wasn't targeted in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

4248528.name: Christian Watson
4248528.note: Packers passing game coordinator Jason Vrable said Monday that Watson (ribs) is sore but "doing great," Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

4257364.name: Zavier Scott
4257364.note: Chicago signed Scott from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.

4258173.name: Nico Collins
4258173.note: Collins caught two of five targets for six yards in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

4259305.name: Bo Melton
4259305.note: Melton caught one of his two targets for four yards and logged a 24-yard kickoff return in the Packers' 20-17 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

4259545.name: D'Andre Swift
4259545.note: Swift rushed 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns and brought in two of three targets for 10 yards in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

4262921.name: Justin Jefferson
4262921.note: Jefferson brought in five of nine targets for 33 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

4360238.name: Dameon Pierce
4360238.note: The Eagles placed Pierce (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday

4360248.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
4360248.note: Pitts caught two of five targets for six yards during Sunday's 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers.

4360310.name: Trevor Lawrence
4360310.note: Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing three times for 10 yards in the Jaguars' 42-7 win over the Colts on Sunday.

4360423.name: Michael Penix Jr.
4360423.note: Penix completed eight of 24 passes for 125 yards with no touchdowns and four interceptions while rushing five times for 11 yards in the Falcons' 16-0 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

4360438.name: Brandon Aiyuk
4360438.note: Aiyuk is close to hiring new representation and is expected to file for reinstatement to the NFL in the near future, according to NFL reporter Jordan Schultz.

4360516.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
4360516.note: The Giants placed Tracy (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

4360569.name: Jordan Mason
4360569.note: Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions on Sunday.

4360635.name: Chig Okonkwo
4360635.note: Okonkwo tallied two catches (on four targets) for 32 yards during Sunday's 27-10 win versus the Eagles.

4360689.name: Tyler Shough
4360689.note: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.

4360739.name: Simi Fehoko
4360739.note: Fehoko is listed as a starting receiver on the Cardinals' unofficial depth chart heading into Sunday's game at Seattle, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

4360761.name: Michael Wilson

4710714.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
4710714.note: Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

4710855.name: Konata Mumpfield
4710855.note: Mumpfield caught one of two targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win at Las Vegas.

4711533.name: Ollie Gordon II
4711533.note: Gordon carried the ball 19 times for 69 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He failed to catch his only target.

4722908.name: Drew Ogletree
4722908.note: Ogletree (knee) is active Week 8 against the Jaguars.

4723086.name: Colston Loveland
4723086.note: Loveland secured seven of nine targets for 65 yards and lost a fumble in the Bears' 34-17 win over the Seahawks on Monday night.

4723820.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
4723820.note: Cooper did not garner a target during Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

4808766.name: Mason Taylor
4808766.note: Taylor caught three of five targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

4808839.name: Isaiah Bond
4808839.note: Bond went without a target while taking the field for eight of the Browns' 70 snaps on offense in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers. He returned one kickoff for 26 yards.

4831959.name: Eli Raridon
4831959.note: Raridon had one reception for five yards on four targets in New England's 24-19 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

4832800.name: Denzel Boston
4832800.note: Boston caught six of 11 targets for 37 yards during Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

4832955.name: Emmett Johnson
4832955.note: Johnson carried the ball once for 15 yards and caught all five of his targets for 128 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos. He added 44 yards on his only kickoff return.

4837248.name: Fernando Mendoza
4837248.note: Mendoza didn't play in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

4869645.name: Caleb Douglas
4869645.note: Douglas caught four of six targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 24-19 loss to the Patriots.

4870612.name: Zachariah Branch
4870612.note: Coach Kevin Stefanski noted Monday that Branch (hamstring) won't play Sunday against the Bengals, William McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

4870653.name: KC Concepcion
4870653.note: Concepcion caught three of four targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

4870795.name: Makai Lemon
4870795.note: Lemon caught six of nine targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 27-10 loss to the Commanders.

4870808.name: Jeremiyah Love
4870808.note: Arizona placed Love (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

4870847.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
4870847.note: Lane caught his only target for 13 yards in Sunday's 36-10 loss to the Bills.

4874509.name: DJ Giddens
4874509.note: Giddens racked up 43 yards on six carries in Indianapolis' Week 8 loss to Jacksonville on Sunday.

4879276.name: Bryce Lance
4879276.note: Lance reeled in all two targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh.

4880236.name: Will Kacmarek
4880236.note: Kacmarek (hamstring) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's battle against the Patriots, C. Isaiah Smalls II of the Miami Herald reports.

4880281.name: Jordyn Tyson
4880281.note: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that the Saints will decide by Wednesday whether to open Tyson's (hamstring) 21-day practice window this week, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

4882093.name: Bhayshul Tuten
4882093.note: The Jaguars listed Tuten (ankle/foot) as a non-participant in Tuesday's practice.

4883647.name: Elic Ayomanor
4883647.note: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

4887558.name: Emanuel Wilson
4887558.note: Wilson played just seven snaps -- all on special teams -- in Monday's 34-17 loss to the Bears.

4890973.name: Ashton Jeanty
4890973.note: Jeanty rushed twice for nine yards while catching three of four targets for 64 yards in Sunday's 38-33 win over the Jets.

4911851.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
4911851.note: Allen (hamstring) does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

4912218.name: Cyrus Allen
4912218.note: Allen caught two of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 28-24 loss to the Broncos.

4912274.name: Sione Vaki
4912274.note: Vaki rushed 11 times for 65 yards in Sunday's 19-15 win over the Vikings. He added one catch for five yards on one target.

5081397.name: Dylan Sampson
5081397.note: Sampson rushed one time for seven yards and caught six of eight targets for 62 yards in Sunday's 27-6 loss to the Steelers.

5081432.name: Antonio Williams
5081432.note: Williams caught five of seven targets for 54 yards during Sunday night's 27-10 win over the Eagles.

5081999.name: CJ Donaldson
5081999.note: Donaldson (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Steelers in Paris.

5082269.name: Dean Connors
5082269.note: Connors (hand) was placed on IR on Tuesday, Blaine Grisak of SI.com reports.

5083076.name: Harold Fannin Jr.
5083076.note: Fannin brought in 10 of 12 targets for 154 yards in the Browns' 27-6 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

5083315.name: Kenyon Sadiq
5083315.note: Sadiq caught one of two targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 38-33 loss to the Raiders.

5083754.name: Ryan Flournoy
5083754.note: Flournoy caught three of four targets for 38 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 overtime loss to the Cardinals.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.note: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

5093923.name: Andrew Armstrong
5093923.note: Armstrong caught one of two targets for three yards during Sunday night's 20-3 loss to Seattle.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.note: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.note: Runyon (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jets, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.note: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.note: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
